# Vendor dashboard

Independent Next.js 16 seller dashboard shell for the marketplace. It is a UI-only demonstration: every metric and table row is a fixture, authentication is intentionally not connected, and no seller registration, onboarding, payment, payout, or commission workflow is exposed.

After the repository-wide install has completed, use `pnpm --filter @marketplace-v2/vendor dev` to open the app on port `7001`. Static checks are available through the package's `lint`, `typecheck`, and `test` scripts.
